title: Design TinyURL
description: Design a URL-shortening service with durable short-code mappings, fast redirects and explicit expiration semantics.
functionalRequirements: Create short links and redirect them to the original URL
Collect click counts asynchronously as an extension
nonFunctionalRequirements: Redirect server p95 below 50 ms within one region, excluding client network time
A successful creation must not silently lose its mapping
constraints: 1 million new links and 100 million redirects per day; assume a 5x traffic peak
Average stored mapping is 500 bytes before indexes and replication
Custom aliases are unique; expired or deleted links must not redirect indefinitely

scale.assumption: Synthetic interview workload, not a claim about any named company's actual traffic.

storageEstimates.name: One year of mapping records before deletion

notes: A 7-character Base62 namespace has 62^7 possible codes; random allocation still needs collision detection.
The byte estimate excludes indexes, object overhead and analytics retention.
CDN and analytics are optional; aliases and expiry are authoritative in the mapping store.
